product_overview: news_paper_app is a Flutter-based news application that lets users browse live news by category, search articles, view article details, and manage saved favorites. It also includes Firebase authentication, push notifications, and customizable language/theme settings.
core_goals: Provide authenticated access with email/password and social sign-in options.
Deliver a responsive news browsing experience with categorized feeds and article details.
Enable fast keyword-based article search with real-time results.
Allow users to save articles locally for offline access and later review.
Support user customization through language selection and light/dark theme switching.
Surface in-app and push notifications for timely news updates.
Provide access to privacy policy information within the app.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can register, log in, and maintain a persistent session using Firebase Auth, including Google and Facebook sign-in options.
user_flows: POST /auth/register with valid email and password -> Receive 201 with created user account -> POST /auth/login with the same credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT/auth session token -> GET /auth/session -> Receive 200 with persisted authenticated user state
POST /auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> User remains unauthenticated
POST /auth/google-sign-in with valid Google account -> Receive 200 with authenticated session -> GET /auth/session -> Receive 200 with active user profile
POST /auth/facebook-sign-in with valid Facebook account -> Receive 200 with authenticated session -> GET /auth/session -> Receive 200 with active user profile

features.name: News Feed & Article Browsing
features.description: Users can browse top news headlines organized by categories and open article details for full content and external links.
user_flows: GET /news/categories -> Receive 200 with category list -> GET /news?category=technology -> Receive 200 with articles for the selected category -> GET /articles/{articleId} -> Receive 200 with full article details and external URL
GET /news/categories -> Receive 200 with category list -> GET /news?category=invalid-category -> Receive 400 with category validation error
GET /articles/{articleId} -> Receive 200 with article content, cover image, author, and publication date -> Open external article URL using the provided link
GET /articles/{articleId} with a non-existent articleId -> Receive 404 article not found error

features.name: Search
features.description: Users can search for news articles by keyword and view matching results in real time.
user_flows: GET /search?q=climate -> Receive 200 with matching article results -> GET /articles/{articleId} -> Receive 200 with selected article details
GET /search?q=breaking -> Receive 200 with result list -> User refines query with GET /search?q=breaking%20news -> Receive 200 with updated results
GET /search?q= -> Receive 400 with missing query error
GET /search?q=unmatchedkeyword -> Receive 200 with empty results set

features.name: Saved Articles
features.description: Users can bookmark articles, persist them offline, review saved items, and remove bookmarks from local storage.
user_flows: POST /saved-articles with articleId and article data -> Receive 201 with bookmark saved confirmation -> GET /saved-articles -> Receive 200 with saved articles list -> DELETE /saved-articles/{articleId} -> Receive 200 with bookmark removed confirmation
GET /saved-articles -> Receive 200 with empty list when no bookmarks exist
POST /saved-articles with duplicate articleId -> Receive 409 with already saved error
DELETE /saved-articles/{articleId} with unknown articleId -> Receive 404 with bookmark not found error

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Users can view received notifications in-app and receive push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging and local notifications.
user_flows: GET /notifications -> Receive 200 with notification list -> User opens a notification item -> GET /notifications/{notificationId} -> Receive 200 with notification details
POST /notifications/device-token with valid FCM token -> Receive 200 with token registration confirmation -> Receive push notification via FCM -> Local notification is displayed in-app
GET /notifications -> Receive 200 with empty notification list when none have been received
GET /notifications/{notificationId} with invalid notificationId -> Receive 404 notification not found error

features.name: Settings & Customization
features.description: Users can switch themes, change application language between English and Arabic, and view the privacy policy.
user_flows: GET /settings -> Receive 200 with current language and theme preferences -> PUT /settings/theme with dark mode selection -> Receive 200 with updated theme -> PUT /settings/language with ar -> Receive 200 with updated locale to Arabic

GET /settings -> Receive 200 with current preferences -> PUT /settings/theme with light mode selection -> Receive 200 with updated theme -> PUT /settings/language with en -> Receive 200 with updated locale to English
PUT /settings/language with unsupported locale code -> Receive 400 with validation error
GET /privacy-policy -> Receive 200 with privacy policy content

code_summary.description: A Flutter news application with authentication, news feed, search, article details, saved/favorite articles, notifications, settings, and dark/light theme switching.
features: Authentication (Login, Register, Firebase Auth, Google & Facebook Sign-In)
News Feed (Home page displaying news articles by categories)
Article Details (View full article details and open external URL)
Saved Articles (Bookmark and persist offline favorite articles using Hive)
Notifications (Notification page, FCM background messaging, local notifications)
Settings (Language selector, Theme switcher light/dark, Privacy Policy page)
